_readme: Central affiliate link registry for growingmj.com. Each key is an affiliate ID referenced in article HTML as href="[[AFFILIATE:<id>]]". The 'url' field is a PLAIN (non-tagged) product or search URL. Do not add an Amazon tracking tag here manually for every entry -- instead set 'amazon_tag' below once you're approved, then run scripts/apply_affiliate_links.py to stamp every placeholder across the whole site in one pass. See README.md for full instructions.
